name: Generic coated particle: a 10 ms overpower to about 51 times the compact's steady power, from the steady state (illustrative)
label: synthetic
description: ILLUSTRATIVE and SYNTHETIC: the generic coated particle of synthetic-triso-compact-steady (the same dimensions, synthetic conductivities, gap and 900 K matrix), started from its steady state at the compact's 11.65 mW per particle, then given a 10 ms triangular overpower to 0.6 W (about 51 times the steady power) at 10 ms, back to 11.65 mW at 20 ms. The power history is an input in W per particle, not a result: FEED computes no kinetics here. The heat capacity of each region is a synthetic number of the right order for the material (kernel 3, buffer 1.5, inner and outer PyC 2.5, SiC 3.5 MJ/m3/K), not a sourced property. The five limits are ILLUSTRATIVE numbers chosen for this example (1000 K in every region), not design limits of any particle; each says so in its source. The case shows the heat wave: the kernel rises first, the layers follow, and by 0.5 s the particle is within about 1 K of its starting state. No statement is made about failure; stress, swelling, fission gas and kernel migration are not modelled. Thermal only.
